### Two-way counter-proof

- Alternatives excluded: disputing an older dropped-batch violation ("the app offers the dispute on the most recent dropped-batch violation"); excluding expired clearings from the standing figure ("whatever their removal reason"); counting 4-star ratings as praise ("ratings below 5 stars do not count"); counting the 3-star low rating in 4b ("ratings of 3 stars or more do not"); deciding the late-delivery dispute at 3 lateness credit (baseline) → 0 removed, which changes the standing figure (cleared 21 → 6 → 2) and the root to 1.
- "Do only the one thing asked": handing over the dispute at the opening with three disputes submitted and undecided gives a figure the document says is not fixed; at the opening the standing figure is 9 → 2 → root 5 − 2 − 2 = 1. Excluded by the three visible sentences.
- Fall-back 0 ≠ 2.
